definition: To deal with or manage a situation or problem.
example: She handles customer complaints very well.

definition: To intentionally not pay attention to something or someone.
example: Please don't ignore my advice.

definition: A short stop in action or speech.
example: He took a brief pause before continuing his speech.

definition: Lasting for only a limited period of time; not permanent.
example: This is a temporary solution to the problem.

definition: A job that requires special training, education, or skill.
example: Teaching is a respected profession.

definition: To give things out to a number of people, or to spread them over an area.
example: The charity will distribute food to those in need.

definition: To tell someone about a possible danger or problem.
example: They warned us about the bad weather.

definition: (Adjective) Very serious or important.
example: The situation is very grave, requiring immediate action.

definition: Without a home.
example: Many organizations help homeless people.

definition: Enough for a particular purpose; adequate.
example: We have sufficient funds to complete the project.

definition: To interrupt someone or something, or to make someone feel anxious.
example: Please do not disturb the students while they are studying.

definition: A person who is new to an activity and has little experience.
example: He is a novice chess player, but he is learning fast.

definition: The development of events outside a person's control, regarded as predetermined.
example: Some people believe that our fate is already decided.

definition: Relating to the central government, rather than the government of a region or state.
example: The federal government passed a new law.

definition: The feeling of being sorry for someone who is in a bad situation.
example: I have a lot of sympathy for people who lost their homes.

definition: To give food to a person, an animal, or a plant.
example: She needs to feed her dog twice a day.

definition: To disagree with something or someone, often formally.
example: Many people oppose the new building plan.

definition: (Noun) The particular flavour of a food or drink.
example: The cake had a delicious taste of chocolate.

definition: Decaying or spoiled, or morally bad.
example: The apples were rotten and couldn't be eaten.

definition: To exchange one thing for another.
example: Can we swap seats so I can see better?

definition: (Of fruit or crops) Fully developed and ready to be eaten or used.
example: The bananas are ripe and ready to eat.

definition: To produce a copy of something, or to produce young.
example: The printer can reproduce documents in color.

definition: (Noun) A period of time when people stop work to protest something.
example: The workers went on strike for higher wages.

definition: Having parts that are close together; thick.
example: The jungle was very dense, making it hard to walk through.

definition: Causing death.
example: The accident was fatal for three people.

definition: A smaller number or part, especially a number or part that is less than half of the whole.
example: Women make up a minority of the engineers in the company.

definition: A narrow way through something, or a short section of a book or music.
example: We walked through a secret passage in the castle.

definition: The part played by a person or thing in a particular situation.
example: The teacher plays an important role in a child's development.

definition: (Adjective) Morally bad or wrong.
example: The villain in the story had an evil laugh.

definition: A series of connected metal rings or a series of things connected together.
example: He wore a silver chain around his neck.

definition: A circumstance, fact, or influence that contributes to a result.
example: Hard work is a key factor in success.

definition: (Noun) A fight between large armed forces, or a strong argument.
example: The battle lasted for several hours.

definition: A principle or standard by which something may be judged or decided.
example: What are the criteria for selecting the best candidate?

definition: To ask for something earnestly or humbly, or to ask for money or food.
example: The homeless person begged for food.

definition: A sum of money that is owed or due.
example: He worked hard to pay off his student debt.

definition: A remarkable occurrence of two or more events at the same time, apparently by chance.
example: It was a strange coincidence that we both wore the same shirt.

definition: An area, especially part of a country or the world having definable characteristics.
example: This region is famous for its beautiful mountains.

definition: (Verb) To dismiss someone from a job.
example: The company had to sack several employees due to budget cuts.

definition: The full extent of something from end to end; the amount or period of time that something exists or happens.
example: The bridge has a long span over the river.

definition: The arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.
example: The structure of the building is very modern.

definition: The money one has saved, especially through a bank or investment plan.
example: She used her savings to buy a new car.

definition: The health, happiness, and fortunes of a person or group.
example: The government is responsible for the welfare of its citizens.

definition: The way a thing turns out; a consequence.
example: The outcome of the experiment was unexpected.

definition: A government department headed by a minister.
example: The Ministry of Education sets school policies.
